pages.title: A Needle for Secrets
pages.text: Learn the native search tool before setting off for magical ruins.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Craft the Wayward Compass using its installed JEI recipe, then read its native target-selection tooltip. It locates supported structures; owning it does not prove visiting them.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Wayward Compass finds nearby Catacombs; it guides the route without bypassing boss rules.
